name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Drill goes with Steel if and only if Titanium goes with Oscilloscope.
Either Wrench goes with Hertz or Wrench goes with Steel.
Between Reactor and Rover, one goes with Concrete and the other with Steel.
Steel goes with exactly two of Diesel, Pipeline, and Drill.
Rover goes with exactly one of Watt, Titanium, or Drill.

hints.text: Suppose Reactor went with Titanium — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Reactor goes with Titanium.
Reactor goes with Titanium, so it can't also go with Concrete.
Reactor goes with Titanium, so it can't also go with Steel.
…but now the clue “Between Reactor and Rover, one goes with Concrete and the other with Steel” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Reactor does not go with Titanium.

hints.text: Suppose Pipeline didn't go with Titanium — that hits a contradiction, so it does.
chain: Start by assuming Pipeline does not go with Titanium.
In Project × Material, Titanium must go with Rover — every other Project is already crossed out for it.
Rover goes with Titanium, so it can't also go with Concrete.
Rover goes with Titanium, so it can't also go with Steel.
…but now the clue “Between Reactor and Rover, one goes with Concrete and the other with Steel” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
